2. It establishes player 'o's presence in the most valuable column, providing player 'o' with their own opportunities for connections in all directions.

In terms of perfect play game theory, responding in Column 3 is one of the three optimal moves (along with Columns 2 and 4) that minimize player 'x's first-player advantage. Column 3 is a direct and standard response to maintain balance in the center.
